slices.title: Map existing ID stores to explicit port boundaries
slices.enables: Document and type the existing blob, event, world, and sync store seams without merging their authority; identify consumer-owned files and compatibility adapters.

tests.oracle: A new architecture/contract test fails when an existing subsystem is assigned to a single generic store; oracle is the audited seam map plus compile-time port ownership checks.

slices.title: Define versioned capability-oriented port contracts
slices.enables: Introduce separate store, blob, event-log, world, object-bucket, stream, and request-transport contract types with capability declarations, semantic guarantees, limits, and typed unsupported errors. This is the sole owner of common crate root exports/Cargo manifests and the shared test-vector schema; consumers add distinct module files and do not edit those roots.

tests.oracle: Capability mismatch currently reaches an adapter side effect; reference negotiation model requires rejection before side effects.

slices.title: Specify redb and Turso/SQLite capability profiles
slices.enables: Implement required port profiles for redb and Turso/libSQL; state transaction, durability, scan, retry, and timeout ambiguity semantics without claiming identical atomicity.

requires.condition: consume owned contract only; do not wait for full sibling program

tests.oracle: Shared state-machine fixture diverges or a remote timeout is reported as definite rollback; oracle is abstract store model plus injected-fault expected outcomes.

slices.title: Build shared store conformance fixtures and capability reports
slices.enables: Create portable conformance vectors and machine-readable required/optional capability reports; run the suite against redb and Turso/SQLite, with IndexedDB profile reserved for its verdict.

tests.oracle: An adapter can pass while violating abstract reference-state transitions; oracle is deterministic model plus emitted capability report.

slices.title: Implement ordered lifecycle hooks and fixed acceptance gate
slices.enables: Add typed prepare/commit/outbox lifecycle hooks with deterministic order, bounded context, reentrancy policy, typed errors, and an unbypassable signature/validation/replay/tenant authorization gate; local producers sign before admission. Enumerate all normal paths before claiming completeness; see 9110-13.

tests.oracle: Malicious hook/local path accepts unsigned, invalid, replayed, or cross-tenant data; oracle is generated gate invariant matrix and hook state-machine model.

slices.title: Add durable outbox recovery and at-least-once hook delivery

tests.oracle: Crash between commit and callback loses or falsely rolls back an event; oracle is model-based crash injection with durable event-ID accounting.

slices.enables: Demonstrate a second stream/transport adapter using existing stable contracts and document ack, ordering, redelivery, replay, retention, and limits; do not promise exactly-once.
